question: Where’s the closest café on the way from Sea Life Aquarium, San Antonio, TX toward Spring Lake Glass-Bottom Boat Tour, San Marcos, TX?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.485816 29.424103)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-97.930627 29.893289)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.485816 29.424103)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.485816 29.424103)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Sea Life Aquarium, San Antonio, TX

[3].display_name: Spring Lake Glass-Bottom Boat Tour, San Marcos, TX
